about_the_game:
Heart of Mycelium is cozy autumn adventure with mysteries and horrors waiting beneath the surface!

Features

  • Beautiful pixel art environments! Journey through a hand-crafted world illustrated in vibrant pixel graphics. 

  • A seamless blend of combat and platforming! Navigate precise platforming or engaging enemy encounters with a versatile dash attack and tight controls. 

  • Meet all sorts of fungal characters. Every mushroom has something interesting to say, if you listen closely enough. 

  • 10+ atmospheric areas to traverse! Explore a captivating world with everything from a pinecone city to a deep sea reef of morel mushrooms. You are sure to find something new at every corner, some things less pleasant than others.

  • 40+ unique enemies and 5 mighty bosses! No two creatures are the same, each requiring a unique approach to defeat. Battle a seahorsefly firing a barrage of babies or bounce on the limbs of a spidercrab to reach up high!

  • Gain the powers of different mushrooms. Pick up mushrooms on your journey and attune with their unique abilities.

  • Horrors below. On your journey you will encounter animals, plants, mushrooms and... something else entirely.
